sql.customFieldSql.brs.ahjList: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj a where archived is not true order by a.name
sql.customFieldSql.brs.ahjList.smartlist: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj a where archived is not true
sql.customFieldSql.brs.utilityCompanyList: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj_utility a where archived is not true order by a.name
sql.customFieldSql.brs.utilityCompanyList.sm: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj_utility a where archived is not true
sql.customFieldSql.brs.proposalLogNumbers: select plh.id, plh.proposal_nbr as name from brs.proposal_log_history plh where plh.project_id = :projectId order by plh.proposal_nbr
sql.customFieldSql.brs.proposalLogNumbers.sm: select plh.id, plh.proposal_nbr as name from brs.proposal_log_history plh
sql.customFieldSql.brs.designLogNumbers: select dlh.id, dlh.reference_nbr as name from brs.design_log_history dlh where dlh.project_id = :projectId order by dlh.design_log_id
sql.customFieldSql.brs.designLogNumbers.smar: select dlh.id, dlh.reference_nbr as name from brs.design_log_history dlh
sql.customFieldSql.brs.availableStates: select s.id, s.state as name from flow.state s inner join flow.company_state cs on s.id = cs.state_id where cs.company_id = :companyId order by s.state
sql.customFieldSql.flow.states: select s.id, s.state as name from flow.state s order by s.state
sql.customFieldSql.flow.postalCodes: select id, postal_code as name, concat_ws('/', place_name, admin_name1) as description from flow.postal_code order by postal_code asc
sql.customFieldSql.flow.postalCodes.lazy: select id, postal_code as name, concat_ws('/', place_name, admin_name1) as description from flow.postal_code where case when :query is not null then postal_code like :query || '%' else 1 = 1 end order by postal_code asc limit 50
sql.customFieldSql.brs.ahjSpecificInstallati: select concat('AHJ Specific Requirements: ', chr(13), chr(13), text_value) as text_value from brs.project_details pd inner join brs.ahj a on a.id = pd.ahj inner join brs.ahj_inspection ai on ai.ahj_id = a.id inner join brs.ahj_inspection_custom_field_value aicfv on aicfv.ahj_inspection_id = ai.id where custom_field_group_assignment_id = 207 and pd.project_id = :projectId
sql.customFieldSql.brs.designLogBomValue: select bom as text_value from brs.design_log_history dlh where project_id = :projectId and id = ( select int_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv where ppscfv.project_process_step_id = :ppsId and ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id in ( select cfga.id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id where cfga.custom_field_id = 9109 and cfg.process_step_id is not null and cfga.archived is false and cfg.archived is false ))
